description: Presidential Secretariat - Functions & Duties of Minister of Investment Promotion
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the President (a named individual, Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and contains detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends the assignment of functions, duties, and institutions for the "Minister of Technology" and creates a new "Minister of Investment Promotion" with a comprehensive list of specific duties, departments, and laws under their purview. This content includes both the "who" (the President making the change) and the "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid gazette.
